name: fetch_pseudopotential
description: fetch the hydrogen pseudopotential the scans use, PSLibrary's H.pbe-rrkjus_psl.1.0.0.UPF, anonymously and read-only from pseudopotentials.quantum-espresso.org into runs/inputs/pseudo, and keep it only when its bytes are the ones the builder read; a file already there with those bytes is not fetched again

file.description: the pseudopotential's path, relative to this directory

sha256.description: its content hash, the one the builder read

fetched.description: false where the file was there already with those bytes

safety_gate.place: src/gate.py, consulted by src/run_tool.py before the call
